title: One Hurricane Hit 215 mph, Faster Than Any Storm Ever Measured

scenes.text: One hurricane hit 215 miles an hour. Nothing has been faster.
It was Hurricane Patricia, in October 2015, off the coast of Mexico.
In just 24 hours, its winds jumped from 85 miles an hour to 205.
Its pressure fell to 872 millibars, the lowest ever recorded in the Western Hemisphere.
Warm, deep water fed it like fuel, and almost nothing slowed it down.
It was the fastest wind any hurricane has ever had.

description:
Hurricane Patricia hit 215 miles an hour in October 2015, the highest sustained winds ever measured in a hurricane.
Its winds jumped by 120 miles an hour in just 24 hours.
Would you ever stay for a storm like this?
first_comment: What is the scariest storm you have ever seen?
